title: Real-Time 2D Fluid Simulation
description: Continuous incompressible fluid, dye transport, interaction, diagnostics, and controls.
look_for: Drag slowly, then flick quickly. Watch dye follow the flow, change viscosity, and clear the dye without resetting the flow.

title: 3D Hydraulic Erosion Laboratory
description: Mutable terrain with water flow, sediment transport, erosion, deposition, and 3D diagnostics.
look_for: Watch water run downhill, carve channels, and deposit sediment. Add water or edit terrain, then change erosion and evaporation settings to see what responds.

title: Modular Synthesizer and Sequencer
description: Multi-track Web Audio workstation with stable scheduling, synthesis, effects, visualization, and WAV export.
look_for: Start audio, edit steps while the sequencer plays, and change tempo or swing. Play a few notes, turn an effect knob, and export a WAV.

title: Soft-Body, Cloth, and Constraint Playground
description: PBD-style cloth, ropes, balloons, soft bodies, collision, tearing, stress, and direct manipulation.
look_for: Grab and stretch cloth, pin a corner, then cut or tear it. Add another body, change stiffness or wind, and watch collisions and stress.

title: Black Hole and Gravitational Lensing Explorer
description: Ray-integrated lensing, accretion disk, redshift, Doppler effects, camera controls, and diagnostics.
look_for: Orbit the black hole, inspect lensing and Doppler effects, and select a ray to inspect its path. Look for geometry that changes with your viewpoint.

title: Wave Interference and Diffraction Laboratory
description: Grid-based wave equation with interference, diffraction, media, phased arrays, and live probes.
look_for: Add two sources, move a barrier, and draw a lens. Watch the wave pattern change, then place a probe and compare its trace with nearby waves.

title: Orbital Mechanics and Mission-Planning Sandbox
description: N-body integration, trajectory prediction, maneuver nodes, reference frames, telemetry, and error tracking.
look_for: Add a maneuver and watch the predicted orbit change before the burn. Advance time through it, compare the actual path, and switch reference frames.

title: SDF and Constructive Solid Geometry Studio
description: Ray-marched SDF primitives, CSG composition, editing, picking, materials, diagnostics, and export.
look_for: Add two shapes, overlap them, then try subtraction and intersection. Move one shape, select it in the viewport, and save and reload the scene.

title: Falling-Sand Alchemy Sandbox
description: Multi-material cellular simulation with heat, phases, chemistry, electricity, growth, and explosions.
look_for: Paint lava beside water, set fuel on fire, or send electricity through metal. Look for lasting material changes, then save and reload the result.

title: Procedural Stealth Heist Sandbox
description: Top-down infiltration game with guard perception, sound propagation, alarms, gadgets, procedural missions, and AI diagnostics.
look_for: Make a noise, attract a guard, and break line of sight. Watch investigation turn into pursuit or search, then use a gadget and reach extraction.

title: Factory Automation and Logistics Game
description: Buildable production chains with belts, machines, power, routing, bottlenecks, goals, and live throughput analysis.
look_for: Build a chain from extraction to delivery, then block a belt or starve a machine. Watch queues and output change; save and reload the factory.

title: Rhythm-Synchronized Bullet-Hell Game
description: Arcade bullet hell whose procedural music, enemy phases, scoring, replay, and projectile patterns share one stable beat timeline.
look_for: Start the music and play through several measures. Pause and resume, change tempo, and check whether attacks stay on beat while damage and scoring still work.

title: 3D FPV Drone-Racing Simulator
description: Procedural 3D racing course with six-axis flight dynamics, collisions, checkpoints, telemetry, assists, and ghost replay.
look_for: Take off, tilt and turn independently, then pass checkpoints in order. Hit an obstacle, recover, and compare assisted flight with a more manual mode.

title: Evolutionary Ecosystem Laboratory
description: Evolving creatures with inherited traits, sensing, feeding, reproduction, predation, lineage tracking, and intervention tools.
look_for: Follow one creature's energy and offspring, then change food or climate. Speed up time and compare population charts, inherited traits, and the selected creature's behavior.

title: Digital Logic and Tiny-CPU Laboratory
description: Interactive circuit editor with gates, buses, sequential logic, propagation, waveform probes, truth tables, and a tiny CPU preset.
look_for: Wire a switch through a gate to an output, then toggle it. Step a counter's clock, inspect the waveform, and try an invalid connection.

title: Procedural Tactical Roguelike
description: Seeded dungeon crawler with connected generation, line of sight, tactical AI, combat, inventory, status effects, and replayable runs.
look_for: Wait without acting and check that enemies wait too. Open a door, fight around a wall, use an item, then save and reload the turn.

title: Time-Loop Physics Puzzle Game and Editor
description: Record-and-replay echo characters cooperate across deterministic physics puzzles, with handcrafted levels and an integrated editor.
look_for: Record yourself holding a pressure plate, reset, and let the echo help you through a door. Edit a level, play it, and undo a change.

title: 3D Weather and Storm Laboratory
description: Interactive 3D atmosphere with advected heat and moisture, clouds, precipitation, wind, terrain effects, lightning, and diagnostics.
look_for: Inject heat and moisture, change the wind, and watch for delayed changes in clouds or rainfall. Compare diagnostic views and probes with what the scene shows.

title: Node-Based Generative Graphics Studio
description: Visual node graph for procedural textures and animation, with typed connections, live compilation, diagnostics, presets, and export.
look_for: Connect nodes, change a parameter, and watch the image respond. Try an invalid connection or cycle, undo an edit, then save the graph and export a PNG.

title: City Traffic and Transit Simulator
description: Buildable road and transit network with routing, lane behavior, signals, congestion, incidents, ridership, and urban metrics.
look_for: Close a busy road or change a signal, then watch queues and rerouting. Add a bus route and compare ridership, travel times, and congestion.

title: Import Studio: Reliable Data Onboarding
description: CSV/JSON mapping, typed validation, duplicate handling, transactional imports, and retry-safe reconciliation.
look_for: Import the supplied tricky CSV, fix an invalid quantity, and exclude duplicates. Check the preview before committing, repeat the import, and verify that records aren't duplicated.

title: Resource Booker: Conflict-Free Reservations
description: Resource calendars, local-time recurrence, atomic conflict checks, stale-edit protection, and concurrency.
look_for: Try adjacent and overlapping bookings, then compete for one slot from two sessions. Move one recurring occurrence and check that other dates and saved times stay intact.

title: Stockroom: Inventory and Order Fulfillment
description: Inventory ledger, atomic reservations, partial fulfillment, returns, and idempotent stock movements.
look_for: Reserve competing orders, ship only part of one, then cancel the remainder and return stock. Check that available quantities and the movement ledger agree after restart.

title: Workflow Desk: Durable Visual Automation
description: Executable DAG editor, durable workflow runs, approvals, retries, version pinning, and real HTTP effects.
look_for: Run an approval branch, restart while it waits, then approve it. Trigger a failed or lost response and check that retries produce only one receiver effect.

title: API Workbench: Stateful Request Laboratory
description: Request collections, environment snapshots, assertions, streams, cancellation, and out-of-order responses.
look_for: Send a slow request, then a fast one, and keep the fast result selected. Switch environments, cancel a stream, and check that late responses don't overwrite it.

title: Config Workbench: Structural Diff and Merge
description: Synchronized JSON editors, bounded schema validation, immutable versions, three-way merge, and undo.
look_for: Edit a nested value, type invalid JSON, and merge the supplied versions. Resolve conflicts, undo the merge, and check that independent changes and published history survive.

title: Field Notebook: Offline Inspections and Sync
description: Offline forms and photos, persistent outbox, version conflicts, reconnect recovery, and honest sync state.
look_for: Go offline, edit an inspection, add a photo, and reload. Change the same record in another session, reconnect, and inspect the conflict before syncing your chosen changes.

title: Approval Desk: Versioned Change Requests
description: Server-enforced roles, revision-specific approvals, separation of duties, immutable history, and conflicts.
look_for: Submit a revision, approve it with two reviewers, then create a new revision. Check that approvals don't carry over, self-approval fails, and history survives a restart.

title: Sheetcraft: Spreadsheet with a Formula Engine
description: Formula parsing, dependency evaluation, mixed references, cycles, bulk undo, sorting, and durable workbooks.
look_for: Change an input, copy a formula with mixed references, and create a circular dependency. Check recalculation, undo a range paste, and save and reload raw formulas.

title: Project Planner: Dependencies and Capacity
description: Deterministic resource-constrained schedules, working-day calendars, critical paths, Gantt edits, and undo.
look_for: Extend a task, drag another onto a weekend, and inspect the dates. Check resource conflicts, try a dependency cycle, then undo and compare the original schedule.
